Impahla yokuqala, uhlobo, isimo sezulu nokuqala kokuqhakaza kubalulekile; lokhu akulona usuku lokuqala lokuvuna olusebenza yonke indawo noma isivuno sonyaka wezinyanga ezingu-12. Incazelo ikhuluma ngokuhlwanyela nokudlulisela emasimini kodwa ayicacisi ukuthi isikhathi siqala ekuhlwanyeleni noma ekutshaleni ngaphandle. Qinisekisa impahla yokuqala nesikhathi endaweni. Lokhu ukusimama kwamahlumela etiye, akukhona ukuqala kokuthela kwesihlahla sezithelo. Isikhathi sangempela sincike ohlotsheni nasekunakekelweni kwendawo.

Isikhombo sesivuno sokuqala: izinyanga ezingu-18. Isivuno sokuqala esivamile e-KZN emva kokutshala, cishe izinyanga ezingu-18. Isigaba esifanayo sibika izinyanga ezingu-9–11 ezimweni ezinhle zase-Makhathini Flats. Lesi isikhombo sesifunda esivamile, akusona isikhathi esincane kunazo zonke noma isiqinisekiso. Isikhathi sangempela sincike ohlotsheni nasekunakekelweni kwendawo.

Isikhombo sesivuno sokuqala: iminyaka engu-5. Ukuthela okuncane cishe ngonyaka wesi-5 encwadini yase-KZN, ezindaweni eziniselwayo ezinehlobo elishisayo, ubusika obubandayo nomswakama ophansi ngesikhathi sokukhula. Ikhomba izigodi zemifula ezomile zase-Zululand/Lowveld njengezindawo zesifunda ezifanelekile. Indlela yokwandisa, uhlobo nobudala basenkulisa akucacisiwe; lesi isikhombo esijwayelekile esinemibandela, akulona inani elilindelekile epulazini. Isikhathi sangempela sincike ohlotsheni nasekunakekelweni kwendawo.

Isikhombo sesivuno sokuqala: iminyaka engu-3. Incwadi yezithelo ze-citrus yase-KZN; isivuno sokuqala sisho izithelo zokuqala, hhayi ukukhiqiza okugcwele. Ithebula elifanayo linikeza iminyaka engu-23 njengobude bempilo obulindelekile bensimu yezihlahla zezithelo. Isikhathi sangempela sincike ohlotsheni nasekunakekelweni kwendawo.

Isikhombo sesivuno sokuqala: iminyaka engu-3. Umthombo uthi okungenani iminyaka emithathu. Lobu ubudala bokuqala kakhulu, akubona ubudala obuvamile noma umkhawulo ongaphezulu; awukho umkhawulo wakamuva onikeziwe. Isikhathi sangempela sincike ohlotsheni nasekunakekelweni kwendawo.

Isikhombo sesivuno sokuqala: iminyaka engu-4–5. Cishe iminyaka engu-4–5 encwadini yezolimo lwengadi yase-KZN. Isimo esichaziwe yizindawo ezingenasithwathwa, ezifudumele, ezinomswakama zesimo esiseduze nesasezindaweni ezishisayo; uhlobo, ubudala ngesikhathi sokwandiswa nokuqala ensimini akucacisiwe. Lesi isikhombo sesivuno sokuqala, akulona inani lasendaweni eliqinisekisiwe noma ubudala bokuthela ngokugcwele. Isikhathi sangempela sincike ohlotsheni nasekunakekelweni kwendawo.

Isikhombo sesivuno sokuqala: iminyaka engu-4–5. Isikhombo sokuqala ukukhula sase-KZN; lo mthombo uchaza nokuthela kamuva ezindaweni eziphakeme. Akusona isithembiso kuzo zonke izinhlobo noma kuyo yonke indawo yase-SA. Isikhathi sangempela sincike ohlotsheni nasekunakekelweni kwendawo.

Isikhombo sesivuno sokuqala: iminyaka engu-3. Isikhombo sencwadi yase-KZN sokuthela okuncane ngonyaka wesi-3, ezimweni zama-apula zesimo esipholile ezifaneleka kakhulu lapho kuyi-Dry Highland Sourveld. Isiphunzi, uhlobo nobudala bokuqala basenkulisa akucacisiwe. Uhlobo olubiziwe oludinga amakhaza ambalwa lusadinga amakhaza anele ebusika endaweni nokusimama; lokhu akusona isiqinisekiso sogu olufudumele. Isikhathi sangempela sincike ohlotsheni nasekunakekelweni kwendawo.

Isikhombo sesivuno sokuqala: iminyaka engu-3–4. Izitshalo zomango ezixhunyelelwe encwadini yase-KZN ngokuvamile ziqala ukuthela emva kweminyaka engu-3–4. Isimo esichaziwe ukukhiqiza endaweni engenasithwathwa, eshisayo/efudumele eseduze nesimo sasezindaweni ezishisayo, enomswakama ophansi ngesikhathi sokuqhakaza, kuhlanganisa i-Zululand eyomile, i-Valley Bushveld ne-Lowveld. Umbhalo uhlukanisa izitshalo ezixhunyelelwe ne-Peach/Sabre ekhuliswe ngembewu; ungasebenzisi lobu budala esithombeni esingaqoshiwe noma ucabange ama-kg onyaka. Isikhathi sangempela sincike ohlotsheni nasekunakekelweni kwendawo.

Izimbali nama-pod ngokuvamile kukhiqizwa ngonyaka wesibili wokukhula encwadini efanayo yase-North West. Ukulungela kwamaqabunga akusho ukukhiqiza ama-pod noma izinyanga zokuwakha. Isikhathi sangempela sincike ohlotsheni nasekunakekelweni kwendawo.

Iphepha libika ukuthi i-Hass yaqala ngesizini yayo yesibili ne-Fuerte ngeyesithathu. Isikhathi sangempela sincike ohlotsheni nasekunakekelweni kwendawo.

Tshupiso ya kotulo ya pele: dikgwedi tse 18. Tshupiso ya potoloho ya tlhahiso ya Hluhluwe: dikgwedi tse 18 / 12 = dilemo tse 1.5. Mohlodi o bolela ka ho hlaka hore bolelele ba potoloho bo fapana haholo. Thepa ya ho qala, mofuta, maemo a lehodimo le ho qala ha dipalesa di bohlokwa; sena ha se letsatsi la kotulo ya pele le sebetsang hohle kapa chai ya selemo sa dikgwedi tse 12. Nako ya nnete e itshetlehile ka mofuta le tlhokomelo ya sebaka.

Tshupiso ya kotulo ya pele: dikgwedi tse 12–18. Ho lokela ho sehwa la pele bakeng sa kgwebo ka dikgwedi tse 12–18 tsamaisong e hlalositsweng ya tlhahiso ya Cape. Tlhaloso e bua ka ho jala peo le ho fetisetsa masimong empa ha e hlalose ka ho hlaka hore nako e qala ha ho jalwa peo kapa ha ho jalwa kantle. Netefatsa thepa ya ho qala le nako sebakeng seo. Sena ke ho tsitsisa mahlomela a tee, ha se ho qala ho beha ha sefate sa ditholwana. Nako ya nnete e itshetlehile ka mofuta le tlhokomelo ya sebaka.

Tshupiso ya kotulo ya pele: dikgwedi tse 18. Kotulo ya pele e tlwaelehileng KZN ka mora ho jala, hoo e ka bang dikgwedi tse 18. Serapa sona seo se tlaleha dikgwedi tse 9–11 tlasa maemo a matle a Makhathini Flats. Sena ke tshupiso e tlwaelehileng ya sebaka, ha se nako e nyenyane ka ho fetisisa kapa tiiso. Nako ya nnete e itshetlehile ka mofuta le tlhokomelo ya sebaka.

Tshupiso ya kotulo ya pele: dilemo tse 5. Kotulo e nyenyane hoo e ka bang selemong sa 5 tataisong ya KZN, bakeng sa dibaka tse nosetswang tse nang le lehlabula le tjhesang, mariha a batang le mongobo o tlase nakong ya kgolo. E supa dikgohlo tse ommeng tsa dinoka tsa Zululand/Lowveld e le dibaka tse loketseng tsa sebaka. Mokgwa wa ho atisa, mofuta le dilemo tsa sethopo ha di a bolelwa; sena ke tshupiso e akaretsang e nang le dipehelo, ha se bongata bo lebelletsweng polasing. Nako ya nnete e itshetlehile ka mofuta le tlhokomelo ya sebaka.

Tshupiso ya kotulo ya pele: dilemo tse 3. Tataiso ya citrus ya KZN; kotulo ya pele e bolela ditholwana tsa pele, e seng tlhahiso e felletseng. Tafole yona eo e fana ka bophelo bo lebelletsweng ba serapa sa ditholwana ba dilemo tse 23. Nako ya nnete e itshetlehile ka mofuta le tlhokomelo ya sebaka.

paragraphs.text: Isikhombo sesivuno sokuqala: iminyaka engu-3. Isikhombo sencwadi yase-KZN sokuthela okuncane ngonyaka wesi-3, ezimweni zama-apula zesimo esipholile ezifaneleka kakhulu lapho kuyi-Dry Highland Sourveld. Isiphunzi, uhlobo nobudala bokuqala basenkulisa akucacisiwe. Uhlobo olubiziwe oludinga amakhaza ambalwa lusadinga amakhaza anele ebusika endaweni nokusimama; lokhu akusona isiqinisekiso sogu olufudumele. Isikhathi sangempela sincike ohlotsheni nasekunakekelweni kwendawo.

Isikhombo sesivuno sokuqala: iminyaka engu-2–3. Bruyns Hill, iqembu lesimo sezulu nokuphila lase-Natal Midlands lesi-2; i-Hass eniselwayo esiphunzini se-Duke 7 esiphindwe ngendlela ye-clone, 7 x 7 m (izihlahla ezingu-200/ha), yatshalwa ngo-1982–1984. Iphepha libika ukuthi i-Hass yaqala ngesizini yayo yesibili ne-Fuerte ngeyesithathu. Isikhombo seminyaka emibili kuya kwemithathu sichaza lezo zinhlobo ezavivinywa, hhayi wonke ama-avocado noma ubudala bokuqala basenkulisa. Isikhathi sangempela sincike ohlotsheni nasekunakekelweni kwendawo.

Isikhombo sesivuno sokuqala: izinyanga ezingu-13–20. I-KZN DARD isho ngokucacile ibanga lesikhathi kusukela ekutshaleni kuya ekuvuneni nokusukela ekuvuneni kuya ekuvuneni okulandelayo. Izinyanga ziguqulwe zaba iminyaka (13/12 kuya ku-20/12). Lokhu akusona isibikezelo esinedethi noma isikhathi sokuvuna sonyaka sezinyanga zonke. Isikhathi sangempela sincike ohlotsheni nasekunakekelweni kwendawo.

Isikhombo sesivuno sokuqala: iminyaka engu-2–3. Isikhombo semboni se-USDA FAS siphathelene nezithelo ezisezingeni lokuthekelisa emva kwesikhathi esingafika eminyakeni emibili kuya kwemithathu. Ukuthela okuncane ngaphambi kwalokho akukhishelwanga ngaphandle; lokhu akulona usuku lwesivuno sokuqala oluqinisekisiwe. Isikhathi sangempela sincike ohlotsheni nasekunakekelweni kwendawo.

Isikhombo sesivuno sokuqala: iminyaka engu-3. Kushiwo nge-African Delight® kuphela, uhlobo lweplamu lwase-Japan olwakhiwa yi-ARC; “isizini yesithathu yokukhula” ithathwe njengonyaka wesi-3. Isikhathi sangempela sincike ohlotsheni nasekunakekelweni kwendawo.

Isikhombo sesivuno sokuqala: iminyaka engu-3. Umthombo uthi okungenani iminyaka emithathu. Lobu ubudala bokuqala kakhulu, akubona ubudala obuvamile noma umkhawulo ongaphezulu; awukho umkhawulo wakamuva onikeziwe. Isikhathi sangempela sincike ohlotsheni nasekunakekelweni kwendawo.

Isikhombo sesivuno sokuqala: iminyaka engu-3. Incwadi yezithelo ze-citrus yase-KZN; isivuno sokuqala sisho izithelo zokuqala, hhayi ukukhiqiza okugcwele. Ithebula elifanayo linikeza iminyaka engu-23 njengobude bempilo obulindelekile bensimu yezihlahla zezithelo. Isikhathi sangempela sincike ohlotsheni nasekunakekelweni kwendawo.

Isikhombo sesivuno sokuqala: iminyaka engu-4–5. Cishe iminyaka engu-4–5 encwadini yezolimo lwengadi yase-KZN. Isimo esichaziwe yizindawo ezingenasithwathwa, ezifudumele, ezinomswakama zesimo esiseduze nesasezindaweni ezishisayo; uhlobo, ubudala ngesikhathi sokwandiswa nokuqala ensimini akucacisiwe. Lesi isikhombo sesivuno sokuqala, akulona inani lasendaweni eliqinisekisiwe noma ubudala bokuthela ngokugcwele. Isikhathi sangempela sincike ohlotsheni nasekunakekelweni kwendawo.

Isikhombo sesivuno sokuqala: iminyaka engu-3. Incwadi ejwayelekile yamapentshisi yase-KZN; lesi sigaba sikhomba izigodi zemifula zase-Muden, Middelrus nase-Weenen njengezindawo zokukhula ezidinga amakhaza ambalwa. Qinisekisa uhlobo nobudala bokuqala basenkulisa. Isikhathi sangempela sincike ohlotsheni nasekunakekelweni kwendawo.

Isikhombo sesivuno sokuqala: iminyaka engu-4–5. Isikhombo sokuqala ukukhula sase-KZN; lo mthombo uchaza nokuthela kamuva ezindaweni eziphakeme. Akusona isithembiso kuzo zonke izinhlobo noma kuyo yonke indawo yase-SA. Isikhathi sangempela sincike ohlotsheni nasekunakekelweni kwendawo.

Isikhombo sesivuno sokuqala: iminyaka engu-3–4. Izitshalo zomango ezixhunyelelwe encwadini yase-KZN ngokuvamile ziqala ukuthela emva kweminyaka engu-3–4. Isimo esichaziwe ukukhiqiza endaweni engenasithwathwa, eshisayo/efudumele eseduze nesimo sasezindaweni ezishisayo, enomswakama ophansi ngesikhathi sokuqhakaza, kuhlanganisa i-Zululand eyomile, i-Valley Bushveld ne-Lowveld. Umbhalo uhlukanisa izitshalo ezixhunyelelwe ne-Peach/Sabre ekhuliswe ngembewu; ungasebenzisi lobu budala esithombeni esingaqoshiwe noma ucabange ama-kg onyaka. Isikhathi sangempela sincike ohlotsheni nasekunakekelweni kwendawo.

Isikhombo sesivuno sokuqala: izinyanga ezingu-6–12. Isikhombo sezinyanga ezingu-6–12 siphathelene nokuvunwa kokuqala kwamaqabunga emva kokutshala. Izimbali nama-pod ngokuvamile kukhiqizwa ngonyaka wesibili wokukhula encwadini efanayo yase-North West. Ukulungela kwamaqabunga akusho ukukhiqiza ama-pod noma izinyanga zokuwakha. Isikhathi sangempela sincike ohlotsheni nasekunakekelweni kwendawo.

Isikhombo sesivuno sokuqala: izinyanga ezingu-18. Isivuno sokuqala esivamile e-KZN emva kokutshala, cishe izinyanga ezingu-18. Isigaba esifanayo sibika izinyanga ezingu-9–11 ezimweni ezinhle zase-Makhathini Flats. Lesi isikhombo sesifunda esivamile, akusona isikhathi esincane kunazo zonke noma isiqinisekiso. Isikhathi sangempela sincike ohlotsheni nasekunakekelweni kwendawo.

Isikhombo sesivuno sokuqala: iminyaka engu-5. Ukuthela okuncane cishe ngonyaka wesi-5 encwadini yase-KZN, ezindaweni eziniselwayo ezinehlobo elishisayo, ubusika obubandayo nomswakama ophansi ngesikhathi sokukhula. Ikhomba izigodi zemifula ezomile zase-Zululand/Lowveld njengezindawo zesifunda ezifanelekile. Indlela yokwandisa, uhlobo nobudala basenkulisa akucacisiwe; lesi isikhombo esijwayelekile esinemibandela, akulona inani elilindelekile epulazini. Isikhathi sangempela sincike ohlotsheni nasekunakekelweni kwendawo.

Isikhombo sesivuno sokuqala: izinyanga ezingu-18. Isikhombo somjikelezo wokukhiqiza e-Hluhluwe: izinyanga ezingu-18 / 12 = iminyaka engu-1.5. Umthombo usho ngokucacile ukuthi ubude bomjikelezo buhluka kakhulu. Impahla yokuqala, uhlobo, isimo sezulu nokuqala kokuqhakaza kubalulekile; lokhu akulona usuku lokuqala lokuvuna olusebenza yonke indawo noma isivuno sonyaka wezinyanga ezingu-12. Isikhathi sangempela sincike ohlotsheni nasekunakekelweni kwendawo.

Isikhombo sesivuno sokuqala: izinyanga ezingu-12–18. Ukulungela ukusikwa kokuqala kokudayisa ngezinyanga ezingu-12–18 ohlelweni lokukhiqiza lwase-Cape oluchaziwe. Incazelo ikhuluma ngokuhlwanyela nokudlulisela emasimini kodwa ayicacisi ukuthi isikhathi siqala ekuhlwanyeleni noma ekutshaleni ngaphandle. Qinisekisa impahla yokuqala nesikhathi endaweni. Lokhu ukusimama kwamahlumela etiye, akukhona ukuqala kokuthela kwesihlahla sezithelo. Isikhathi sangempela sincike ohlotsheni nasekunakekelweni kwendawo.

Isikhombo sesivuno sokuqala: iminyaka engu-3–5. Ukubuyekezwa kubeka lobu budala beminyaka engu-3–5 ocwaningweni luka-Avakoudjo et al. e-Benin, eNtshonalanga Afrika, hhayi esivivinyweni sokuthela saseNingizimu Afrika. Indlela yokwandisa nezimo zendawo kufanele kuqinisekiswe ngaphambi kokusebenzisa lesi sikhombo endaweni yaseNingizimu Afrika; akubona ubudala obuqinisekisiwe endaweni noma igrafu yesivuno ngokobudala. Isikhathi sangempela sincike ohlotsheni nasekunakekelweni kwendawo.

Nyimele ndi u bveledza kha tropical/subtropical hu dudelaho hu si na ṅwando na ṅukelo ya fhasi nga tshifhinga tsha maluvha, hu tshi katelwa Zululand ho omaho, Valley Bushveld na Lowveld. Maṅwalwa a fhambanyisa zwimela zwo ṱumetshedzwaho na Peach/Sabre yo aluwaho nga mbeu; ni songo shumisa miṅwaha iyi kha tshimela tsha mbeu tshi songo rekhodiwaho kana u humbulela kg dza ṅwaha. Tshifhinga tsha vhukuma tshi ya nga lushaka na ṱhogomelo ya fhethu.

Tshiko tsha khaṋo ya u thoma: miṅwedzi ya 6–12. Tshiko tsha miṅwedzi ya 6–12 tshi amba khaṋo ya u thoma ya maṱari nga murahu ha u ṱavha. Maluvha na khavhi nga u ḓowela zwi bveledzwa kha ṅwaha wa vhuvhili wa u aluwa kha nyendedzi yeneyo ya North West. U lugela ha maṱari a hu khwaṱhisedzi u bveledza khavhi kana miṅwedzi ya u ka. Tshifhinga tsha vhukuma tshi ya nga lushaka na ṱhogomelo ya fhethu.

Tshiko tsha khaṋo ya u thoma: miṅwedzi ya 18. Khaṋo ya u thoma yo ḓoweleaho KZN nga murahu ha u ṱavha, hu ṱoḓaho u vha miṅwedzi ya 18. Phara yeneyo i vhiga miṅwedzi ya 9–11 kha nyimele dzavhuḓi dza Makhathini Flats. Itshi ndi tshiko tsho ḓoweleaho tsha dzingu, a si tshifhinga tshiṱukusa kana khwaṱhisedzo. Tshifhinga tsha vhukuma tshi ya nga lushaka na ṱhogomelo ya fhethu.

Tshiko tsha khaṋo ya u thoma: miṅwaha ya 5. U aṋwa zwiṱuku hu ṱoḓaho u vha kha ṅwaha wa 5 kha nyendedzi ya KZN, fhethu hu sheledzwaho hu re na tshilimo tshi fhisaho, vhuriha vhu rotholelaho na ṅukelo ya fhasi nga tshifhinga tsha u aluwa. I bula mikovhe yo omaho ya milambo ya Zululand/Lowveld sa madzingu o teaho. Maitele a u andisa, lushaka na miṅwaha ya tshimela fhethu ha zwiraba a zwo ngo bulwa; itshi ndi tshiko nga u angaredza tshi re na nyimele, a si tshivhalo tsho lavhelelwaho bulasini. Tshifhinga tsha vhukuma tshi ya nga lushaka na ṱhogomelo ya fhethu.

Tshiko tsha khaṋo ya u thoma: miṅwedzi ya 18. Tshiko tsha mutengelele wa u bveledza wa Hluhluwe: miṅwedzi ya 18 / 12 = miṅwaha ya 1.5. Tshiko tshi amba nga ho livhaho uri vhulapfu ha mutengelele vhu a fhambana nga maanḓa. Zwithu zwa u thoma ngazwo, lushaka, mutsho na u thoma ha maluvha ndi zwa ndeme; itshi a si tshifhinga tsha khaṋo ya u thoma tshi shumaho hoṱhe kana khaṋo ya ṅwaha wa miṅwedzi ya 12. Tshifhinga tsha vhukuma tshi ya nga lushaka na ṱhogomelo ya fhethu.

Tshiko tsha khaṋo ya u thoma: miṅwedzi ya 12–18. U lugela u geriwa lwa u thoma kha zwa vhubindudzi nga miṅwedzi ya 12–18 kha maitele a u bveledza a Cape o ṱalutshedzwaho. Muvhigo u amba nga ha u zwala na u pfukisela masimuni fhedzi a u ṱalutshedzi nga ho livhaho uri tshifhinga tshi thoma musi hu tshi zwalwa kana hu tshi ṱavhiwa nnḓa. Khwaṱhisedzani zwithu zwa u thoma ngazwo na tshifhinga henefho. Izwi ndi u khwaṱhisa matavhi a tie, a si u aṋwa ha muri wa mitshelo. Tshifhinga tsha vhukuma tshi ya nga lushaka na ṱhogomelo ya fhethu.

Maitele a u andisa na nyimele dza henefho zwi tea u khwaṱhisedzwa musi zwi sa athu shumiswa fhethu ha Afrika Tshipembe; iyi a si miṅwaha yo khwaṱhisedzwaho henefho kana girafu ya khaṋo u ya nga miṅwaha.
